info.description: A full-width carousel of pictures that loops forever, under a heading inviting the visitor to follow. It does not call Instagram — the pictures are the ones added below.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Slides
edit.description: The pictures the strip is made of. The strip repeats them until it fills the screen, so a handful is enough.
